Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (g) Option.An employee on deputation may elect to draw either pay in the scale of pay of the deputation post fixed under the normal rules [ FR 22 (I) (a) (1); (I) (a) (2), etc. ], or his basic pay in the parent department from time to time plus personal pay, if any, and Deputation (Duty) Allowance. In the case of deputation/foreign service to CPSEs, this option will not be allowed and their pay will be governed by the orders issued by the Department of Public Enterprises.
